objective: Fix three static-serving defects in apps/server/src/app.ts and add an environment override for the engine thread count in apps/server/src/config.ts. (1) With WEB_DIST set, a GET/HEAD for a path under /assets/ or whose last segment has a file extension that matches no file returns 404 (JSON apiError like other 404s), not index.html; extensionless client routes (/games/abc, /games/abc?x=1) still get index.html. (2) Cache headers: files under /assets/* get `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`; index.html (both at / and via the SPA fallback) gets `no-cache`. (3) Dotfiles in WEB_DIST are not served (GET /.hidden -> 404). (4) loadEngineThreads reads env ENGINE_THREADS first (a positive integer; blank or unset falls back to config/tutor.json engine.threads; any other value throws a clear Error so startup fails loudly). Success: tests in apps/server/test/deploy.test.ts and a config test show each case, and the gate is clean.
